body:
`board.recoverable_review` takes only the last `message` entry, and `board.review_assessment` requires its first line to be exactly `**Assessment: Looks good**` or `**Assessment: Needs work**`. A preamble line, `**Assessment:** Looks good`, `## Assessment: …`, a trailing message such as `Done.`, or Claude splitting one reply into several text blocks loses a valid assessment.

Decision first: amend D-183 to define the accepted shape. Join the trailing `message` entries after the last non-message entry in order, separated by a blank line, and find the first line that is a label after removing Markdown heading and emphasis markers around `Assessment:`: `Assessment: Looks good` or `Assessment: Needs work`, with no other text on the line. Record the whole joined reply as feedback. Reject a reply with no label; if two labels disagree, reject. Keep D-183's requirement that a final message is not a note in general.

Tests: assessment in the first of several text blocks with a trailing `Done.`; preamble line; `**Assessment:** Looks good`; `## Assessment: Needs work`; a trailing message after the label; no label; two conflicting labels; extra text on the label line. An acceptance case with a Claude-like log split into blocks, asserting `reviewed` and the full joined note. Run `rust-board-tests`, `rust-acceptance`, `test --all`, `check --warnings`.

Left out: no attempt to interpret a label outside the trailing message run, and no change to work or investigate runs.
title: review: read split final messages
